CheckTitle: IAM Password Policy is not set
Description: No password policy has been set for IAM users.
Risk: Password policy determines the minimum complexity of passwords set up by IAM users. The default AWS password policy still requires a minimum length, use of multiple character types and other parameters, but is not as strict as typically recommended nowadays.

Recommendation.Text: Set up a custom password policy with higher minimum length, password expiration, and a high password reuse prevention.
